answer: By capping relay fanout per identity and decaying peer scores toward a nadir under sybil flood, the mesh throttles forged gossip before it saturates the lagoon of honest traffic. Each relay must stake a lantern bond whose score-weighted attestations gate propagation, so colluding identities dim together rather than illuminate the swarm. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
